newsitem.title: USA: Network Event Theater says buys firm.
newsitem.headline: Network Event Theater says buys firm.

text.p: Network Event Theater Inc said Monday it has acquired substantially all of the college and high school media and marketing businesses of American Passage Media Corp.
The deal is valued at about $4.75 million.
The lines of business acquired include college newspaper placement operations, college campus postering operations, and a variety of other advertising and event-sponsorship activities.
